rationale: The claim accurately reflects the explicit scope exclusions in EASA NPA 2025-07(B) DS.AI.010(d)(1) and (d)(2), which exclude AI-based systems directly contributing to fatalities or multiple life-threatening injuries as well as online-learning systems with safety effects. The challenge's caution—that a specific DAA perception function must not be assumed catastrophic without an aircraft-level failure-condition allocation—is preserved by the claim's precise restriction to the project's most demanding flight-critical autonomy case rather than a blanket assertion on all airborne functions.
limitations: NPA 2025-07(B) remains a proposed notice of amendment rather than final adopted AMC/GM; actual exclusion depends on function hazard allocation and architectural mitigations.
